description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for auditing Discord channel permissions within the openclaw project, including collecting channel IDs and performing permission checks via external API calls.

methods.name: shouldAuditChannelConfig
methods.description: Determines if a given Discord guild channel configuration should be audited based on its 'enabled' status.

methods.name: listConfiguredGuildChannelKeys
methods.description: Extracts and returns sorted list of channel IDs from guild configurations that are eligible for auditing.

methods.name: collectDiscordAuditChannelIds
methods.description: Collects and returns channel IDs and count of unresolved channels from the account's guild configurations.

methods.name: auditDiscordChannelPermissions
methods.description: Performs permission checks on specified Discord channels, returning audit results including missing permissions and errors.
